name: @red-cup-engineering/semiotic-voxel-package-normalization-service
description: Converts the potential JavaScript package body into explicitly owned package/deployment carrier descriptors under x-semiotic-voxel without workspace or local-path authority.

scripts.verify: node --check src/normalize-package-body.mjs && node --check src/normalization-market-loop.mjs && node --check bin/normalize-semiotic-voxel-packages.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs

normalize-semiotic-voxel-packages.accepts: one repository root containing independently owned package carriers
normalize-semiotic-voxel-packages.returns: one collision-free ownership and identity rewrite receipt whose x-semiotic-voxel values are exact package/deployment descriptors, never semantic or active-voxel carriers

coordinate-brokered-normalization.accepts: one TRC language-cone receipt and RMN Mark, one resource-brokerage selection, and an injected one-shot actuator
coordinate-brokered-normalization.returns: one resource-brokerage RMN settlement after post-move observation
coordinate-brokered-normalization.transport: ActivityStreams publication evidence or an explicit pending transport intent; no resident queue or daemon is created
